description_full:
🚨 LAST CALL! Registration closes TODAY!

This is your final chance to apply for SEA Limited's Management Associate Programs and take the first step toward a career where you can grow, challenge yourself, and make a real impact.

Don't let the opportunity pass you by!
- Global Management Associate Program (GMAP): bit.ly/SeaGMAP2027
- Finance Management Associate (FMA): bit.ly/FMA2027
- Future Leaders Program (FLP): bit.ly/IDFLPOps2027
- Apprentice Program (AP): bit.ly/IDAP2027

🗓️ Registration closes on 31st October 2026 at 11:59PM (GMT +8)
